description: Shipped procedures for the engine itself. A vertical adds its own bundle alongside this one.

steps.text: Ask for the folder path if the user did not give one.
Index the folder with the document indexing tool.
Report how many files were indexed and name any that failed.

parameters.name: folder_path
parameters.description: Directory on this machine to index

steps.text: If a tool returns an error, say that the tool failed.
Name the tool and quote the error.
Do not invent a successful result.
